     "### Evaluation Metric Setup\n",
-    "We use three metrics to evaluate the model:\n",
     "\n",

+    "We predict three values per day per stock:\n",
+    "- **next_day_low**  - the floor: where to place a bid \n",
+    "- **next_day_high** - the ceiling: where to place an offer  \n",
+    "- **next_day_price** - the expected close\n",
+    "\n",
+    "Together, next_day_low and next_day_high form the **predicted price range** for the day.\n",
+    "We evaluate each separately, then add a range-specific metric:\n",
+    "\n",
+    "- MAE - average KES error per target\n",
+    "- RMSE - penalises large errors more than MAE\n",
+    "- MAPE - percentage error, useful for comparing across stocks at different price levels\n",
+    "- **Range Coverage** - what % of days did the actual price fall inside [predicted_low, predicted_high]? \n",
+    "  A good range should cover ~80–90% of days without being so wide it's useless.\n",
+    "- **Range Width** - average KES width of the predicted range. Narrower is better, as long as coverage stays high."
    ]
